name: baseline-2026-05-10
description: Sanity check against the synthetic case set anchored to 2026-05-10. Cases referenced here come from src/sources/synthetic.py with the default seed (4242).
_must_flag_rationale: 500Syn0001 is the 'metformin XR severe GI upset' case — Adverse Event category, Critical priority. Should be picked up by clinical_flags as adverse_event.
_must_not_flag_rationale: 500Syn0000 is a routine portal-lockout case (priority Medium, no clinical content, no escalation signal). Should not appear in critical sections.
_required_topic_keywords_rationale: The synthetic data has multiple Rx-related and prior-auth categories generating many cases. At least one cluster label should mention each.
